computeProfile.statement: local CPU computation in a disposable provider process (the arms-length venv of the spike); no network, no cloud, no accelerator

costProfile.quotaPolicy: local execution — no quota, no metering, no third-party service

description: The ANCHOR-001 spike adapter (OpenCV 5.0.0 SIFT + RANSAC over a stdio JSON process boundary) registered as the reference lane of the anchor002-anchoring-contract/1 port. Evaluation-stage: the production adapter is gated on a real-photoset evidence run (ANCHOR-001/recommendation.md); the synthetic fixture proves the lane, not the world.
displayName: OpenCV SIFT+RANSAC plan-homography anchoring — reference lane

failureModes.behavior: typed refusal insufficient-features / registration-unreliable — zero hypotheses
failureModes.condition: a textureless still or a plan/still pair without shared texture

failureModes.behavior: AISE-side guard refusal naming the offending field — never admitted as evidence
failureModes.condition: response bytes that violate the closed output vocabulary

failureModes.behavior: typed refusal evidence-bytes-mismatch — the port trusts content ids, not paths
failureModes.condition: content-address mismatch between echoed id and re-hashed bytes

failureModes.behavior: typed timeout failure — bounded termination, no hang, no fabricated response
failureModes.condition: provider exceeds the supervised runner timeout (120 000 ms declared)

fields.description: AISE-owned 64-hex sha-256 content ids (echoed, never invented)
fields.name: evidence[].contentId

fields.description: redundancy floor — fewer stills refuse with insufficient-stills
fields.name: policy.minStills

latencyProfile.statement: cold-process wall times observed over the two spike runs (15 083 / 15 225 ms, python interpreter + numpy/opencv import included); the supervised runner's declared timeout is the spike's own 120 000 ms

license.intendedUse: production floor-plan-to-photoset anchoring adapter behind the anchor002 anchoring contract

memoryProfile.statement: declared recommended footprint for the OpenCV 5.0.0 / numpy 2.5.3 process; memory was not separately measured during the spike (recorded honestly, not invented)

fields.description: closed whole-request outcome vocabulary: anchored | partial | refused
fields.name: status

fields.description: normalized 3x3 plan-raster-px -> still-px homography (h[2][2] === 1; finiteness and normalization are enforced by the contract guard, not by range bounds)
fields.name: hypotheses[].transform.matrix

fields.description: explicit 95% uncertainty budget in meters (never implicit)
fields.name: hypotheses[].uncertainty.budget95M

fields.description: declared support score in [0,1] — NOT a probability
fields.name: hypotheses[].confidence

uncertaintyCharacteristics.notes: declared first-order budget in meters (inlier-residual-first-order-v2.1); confidence is a support score, never a probability. The budget95 covers realized error on 4/10 synthetic-fixture stills (6 exceptions — measurements.md §4, the calibration finding); empirical calibration is gated on the real-photoset run
